scope: Proposition 2.3 of the manuscript “Counterexamples to the Hahn-Wilson conjecture at height two” (preprints/Counterexamples-to-the-Hahn-Wilson-conjecture-at-height-two-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 319 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a90ada966eb41540), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a flat affine groupoid stack N and a map r : Mk → N that quotients the vertical central Z-action on arrows. Its pullback is exact and identifies sheaves on N with sheaves on Mk having trivial vertical Z-action. Moreover f′ = rfk : Xk −→ N is flat and affine. The weight line descends to N, and t = v1 is an invariant Cartier section of O(1) there.
